business_summary: Xi'an Peri Power Semiconductor Converting Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, sale, testing, verification, marketing, and full-cycle technical servicing of high-power semiconductor devices, power electronic devices, and power semiconductor device testing equipment in China and internationally. The company offers power semiconductor devices, including high-power thyristors for DC power transmission, IGBT modules, high-power optical thyristors, high-power rectifier tubes, high-power fast thyristors, heat sinks, and power semiconductor modules; and power electronic application devices, such as high-power rectifiers with split polarity and control systems. It also provides testing equipment and application development devices, including DBC series power semiconductor device discrete and integrated testing equipment, reliability testing equipment, conventional testing equipment for thyristors and diodes, thyristor dynamic and static testing equipment, and IGBT module testing equipment. The company serves the industrial production, power testing, and equipment inspection industries. Xi'an Peri Power Semiconductor Converting Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1953 and is based in Xi'an, China.
